title: Tool Permission Manifest
description: The declaration an approval gate fires on. A tool absent from this file is a tool nothing gates, which is why gate.actions-classified checks the manifest's tool list against this one rather than trusting either alone.

impact.description: none: no effect outside the process. reversible: the system can undo it. irreversible: it cannot be undone. externally-visible: someone outside the organisation can see it. A tool can warrant two; declare the stricter.
